title: Towards Full Pipeline FP8 Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.22870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key technique for improving the reasoning and agentic abilities of large language models (LLMs). Although FP8 quantization can accelerate RL training, maintaining stability throughout an FP8 RL pipeline remains challenging. While previous works have focused on resolving train-inference mismatches using correction techniques like TIS, we reveal that full-pipeline FP8 RL still suffers from severe training instability, manifesting as anomalous mid-training entropy surges and garbled outputs. We trace this instability to a previously overlooked cause: compounded FP8 quantization noise distorts the importance ratio, disproportionately pushing negative-advantage tokens outside the trust region and erroneously zeroing out their gradients. translated_title: 迈向面向大语言模型的全流程FP8强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力和智能体能力的关键技术。尽管FP8量化可以加速RL训练，但在整个FP8 RL流程中保持稳定性仍然具有挑战性。以往的工作主要集中于使用TIS等修正技术来解决训练与推理之间的不匹配问题，而我们发现，全流程FP8 RL仍然存在严重的训练不稳定问题，表现为训练中期的异常熵激增和乱码输出。我们将这种不稳定性追溯到一个此前被忽视的原因：叠加的FP8量化噪声扭曲了重要性比率，不成比例地将负优势token推出信任域之外，并错误地将其梯度置零。因此，病态输出未能得到恰当的惩罚，并在训练过程中不断累积。为解决这一问题，我们提出了校准裁剪，这是一种动态方法……
tldr: 该论文揭示了全流程FP8强化学习训练不稳定的根源在于FP8量化噪声扭曲重要性比率、导致负优势token的梯度被错误置零，并提出动态校准裁剪方法来解决这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that compounded FP8 quantization noise distorts the importance ratio and erroneously zeroes out gradients of negative-advantage tokens, causing severe instability in full-pipeline FP8 RL, and proposes Calibrated Clipping as a dynamic solution.
